policy_expectations_predeclared.strong_vs_struggling: Mean trained probability across common eligible skills is higher for the strong history.
policy_expectations_predeclared.improving_vs_declining: Mean trained probability across common eligible skills is higher for the improving history when total correctness is held approximately constant.
policy_expectations_predeclared.skill_specific_strength_swap: The trained probability for the predeclared focus skill is higher when that skill is strong than when it is weak.
policy_expectations_predeclared.recent_correct_vs_recent_incorrect: Mean trained probability is higher when the same number of correct responses is concentrated recently rather than early.
policy_expectations_predeclared.coverage: The selected game belongs to the admissible coverage/stopping set specified before observing the recommendation.
policy_expectations_predeclared.invariant: Equivalent histories differing only in learner identifier produce identical task, tier, reason, score and candidate ranking.

interpretation_boundaries: Policy-Expectation Agreement is agreement with an implementation-specification rubric, not recommendation accuracy or independent pedagogical appropriateness.
Candidate eligibility is expected to remain equal except when the intended outcome contrast activates documented Tier B evidence rules.
Synthetic response histories do not establish learning benefit, screening accuracy or clinical validity.
No pair is selected or removed based on whether its recommendation changes.
